text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City got hurt, so I brought her to 
the infirmary. ...Though she didn't want 
to come.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Geez, stop making such a big fuss over 
something like this!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Argh, so annoying...! Now everyone around 
us is gonna think I'm some greenhorn who 
can't even train over something minor like 
this...!
choice_data_list: Still, we can't take an injury lightly—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Don't underestimate it"? Who, me?! 
Something like this is an absolute breeze!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
T-That ain't it! Just now, it was... You 
know! I meant I wanna meet strong people!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that, get me back on the track 
now! I'm not letting anyone look down on 
me!"
choice_data_list:
If we're just keeping an eye on things 
while we do it, then...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Promise me one thing. Once I've 
rested, give me a menu that's even tougher 
than before...!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I want folks to think I wasn't just 
sitting out 'cause of an injury, but that 
we were having a strategy meeting for a 
brand-new menu...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
All right, weights, let's do weights! I'm 
going max weight!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Shut up! An injury like this is nothin'! 
In fact, I'm gonna show 'em I'm in top 
shape!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had her stop immediately, and Espoir 
City grudgingly left the training gym 
behind...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Y-Yesss! D-Did you see that?! Let's 
keep up this momentum for training!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were no apparent lingering effects 
from the injury after that, so training 
continued within safe limits.
